name: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
summary: Amsterdam research university with 19 English-taught bachelor's, from AI, econometrics and maths to PPE, Law in Society and psychology.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma meets the entry rule. English: an English-taught or bilingual IB, or English A Lang & Lit SL 7/HL 6. Maths AA HL for econometrics, maths, CS, Business Analytics; none in social sciences, humanities, law.

apply.via: Studielink, then the VU dashboard on vu.nl

dates.label: VU Bachelor's Day on campus (6 and 7 November)
Enrolment: tuition fee paid (15 July for numerus fixus programmes)

programmes.name: Artificial Intelligence
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL or HL, or Maths AI HL.
programmes.about: AI designed to work with people (hybrid intelligence): machine learning and reasoning applied to healthcare robots, smarter triage, misinformation and sustainable energy, with attention to trust and responsibility.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Business Analytics
programmes.about: Mathematics, data analysis, computer science and business combined to turn data into decisions, from stock levels to seat pricing; the programme has run at VU for more than 35 years.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Communication and Information Studies
programmes.ib: Two English tracks: Language and Media, and Applied Linguistics; the Media and Journalism track is taught in Dutch.
programmes.about: How communication works and what language does in it, from persuasion on social media to the words that trigger associations. Two English tracks: Language and Media, and Applied Linguistics.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Communication Science
programmes.about: A scientific approach to media and communication, from misinformation on social media to reputational damage, with a research project on a topic of your choice every semester.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Computer systems from top to bottom, from algorithms and AI to chips, networks and cybersecurity, learning to build software that is secure, scalable and correct from active researchers.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Cultural Anthropology and Development Sociology
programmes.about: How people live together and respond to change, from climate and migration to inequality and identity, studied from within through fieldwork and attention to culture, power and identity.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Econometrics and Data Science
programmes.about: Econometric models combined with machine learning and time-series methods to forecast and decide, from a bank predicting inflation to a supermarket planning fresh stock.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Econometrics and Operations Research
programmes.about: Quantitative tools for economic and operational decisions, such as how financial shocks spread between banks or how hospitals can best use beds and doctors.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Economics and Business Economics
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL or HL, Maths AI HL, or Maths AI SL at grade 5.
programmes.about: How consumers, firms and governments behave in economic systems, from single purchases to global decisions, with questions such as how to stop a bank collapsing.

needs.note: Maths AI SL at grade 5 is also accepted.

programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: History and International Studies
programmes.about: The historical origins of today's global society, such as democracy, inequality and climate change, studied beyond Eurocentric perspectives and with attention to marginalised voices.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: International Business Administration
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL or HL, Maths AI HL, or Maths AI SL at grade 5.
programmes.about: Business in an international setting: marketing across cultures, corporate social responsibility and responsible finance, and working in diverse virtual teams.

needs.note: Maths AI SL at grade 5 is also accepted.

programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Law in Society
programmes.ib: Selective: a motivation-based application form, and possibly a Zoom interview.
programmes.about: A broad legal education (LLB) combined with social science research methods, applied to terrorism, corporate environmental damage, platform workers and asylum.

needs.note: Any IB maths; otherwise pass a maths entry test (VWO Maths C or OMPT-E).

programmes.selectionNote: Selective on motivation: an application form assessed monthly by the Admission Board, sometimes a Zoom interview. Apply early; final EU deadline 1 May.

programmes.name: Literature and Society: English
programmes.about: Literature and culture in English linked to social and political questions past and present, alongside other storytelling such as film, TV series and comics.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Mathematics
programmes.about: A thorough foundation in pure and applied mathematics, from primes in cryptography to maths behind AI and animal skin patterns, with a data-driven or research-oriented path later on.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Media, Art, Design and Architecture
programmes.about: Images, objects and buildings studied together and in context, from Instagram as a museum to tiny houses, tracing their contested histories in a mediated, global world.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Philosophy
programmes.ib: Apply for Philosophy in Studielink, then confirm the English-taught track in your VU dashboard.
programmes.about: Fundamental questions about knowledge, reality and justice asked about current themes, building a critical perspective on science, religion and society. Choose the English track after applying.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Philosophy, Politics and Economics (PPE)
programmes.ib: Selective: 31 points excl. TOK and EE (2025-26 list; 2027 not yet published), motivation, maybe an interview. Maths AA SL/HL, AI HL or AI SL at 5.

separateFrom.name: Philosophy
separateFrom.reason: A different degree (BSc, not BA): selective, with 31 points, a motivation, perhaps an interview and a maths requirement Philosophy does not have.

programmes.about: A small, intensive programme combining philosophy, politics and economics to tackle questions of fairness, democracy, economic crises and environmental policy.

needs.note: Maths AI SL at grade 5 is also accepted.

programmes.selectionNote: Selective: your GPA (Dutch 7.0 equivalent; at least 31 IB points excluding the core), motivation and fit, judged as one dossier; some are interviewed.

programmes.name: Political Science: Global Politics
programmes.about: Politics at the global level: international power relations and how they affect different societies, for careers taking part in or critically following politics.
programmes.selectionNote: No cap: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May and complete your VU application.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.ib: Numerus fixus (600 places, English and Dutch tracks together): apply by 15 January; GPA plus an online test on 6 March 2027 (pass mark 5.5 of 10), then a lottery.
programmes.about: Why people think, feel and behave as they do, and how brain, personality, genes, environment and relationships shape it, applied to health, work, media and sport.
programmes.selectionNote: Numerus fixus, 600 places (English and Dutch tracks). Apply by 15 Jan 2027; GPA plus an online test on 6 March sort you into groups, then a lottery within groups 2 and 3.

notes: Binding study advice: you need at least 42 of 60 first-year credits (EC) to continue, 48 in International Business Administration and 54 in PPE.
Applicants with a diploma from outside the Netherlands pay a non-refundable €100 application fee, and VU's housing offer for internationals covers the first year only.
Mechanical Engineering and Creative Technology run mostly on VU's campus but you apply to the University of Twente; from 2027 Ancient Studies and Archaeology are applied for via UvA.
